title: Heavy tails in Gaussian-process surrogates: code, data and results
description: Python code, stored per-replicate results and a smoke test that reproduce all simulations, tables and figures of N. S. Upadhye and R. K. Mani, 'Heavy tails in Gaussian-process surrogates: process-level profiling degeneracy versus observation-level identifiability' (submitted to Statistica Sinica). Supported by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), Government of India, under its ARG-MATRICS scheme (grant ANRF/ARGM/2025/000532/MTR).
